scope: Focused local review of lease/mutex/cache fencing, migration and sealed-session boundaries; no hosted scanner or cryptographic certification.
threatModel: Offline/corrupted storage and delayed or revoked in-process capabilities
Concurrent cooperating managed writers and explicit session cancellation
No defense claim against compromised host, malicious filesystem owner or authorized malicious key holder

findings.confirmed: Lock during final integrity digest returned plaintext from a locked session
findings.fix: Recheck lock after digest; rejected buffer cleared

findings.confirmed: Revoked approval committed a write queued behind another operation; a queued source write could also commit after unsealing started
findings.fix: Recheck scoped authorization at queue execution and before persistence/commit dispatch and require phase on

findings.confirmed: Uncached build returned a valid artifact after lock during source hashing
findings.fix: Recheck locked/phase state after hashing and before returning artifact

findings.function: migration, inventory, restoration and DiskVaultStore root binding
findings.confirmed: Working-directory changes redirected migration/restoration, inventory reads and low-level lease recovery to a different root
findings.fix: Resolve entry paths/root synchronously and retain absolute vault root

limitations: Storage commit already dispatched cannot be recalled by revocation
Bytes already returned and JavaScript strings cannot be retroactively erased
Both stale mutexes, unknown/foreign/legacy ownership and unbound external leases remain manual-review cases
No new defect confirmed in the reviewed recovery interlock under its cooperating-filesystem assumptions
Formal security-scan skill references and preflight were unavailable; no hosted scan was launched
Full-platform and independent security assurance remain pending

historicalNativeCost.scope: Current baseline native frontend versus frozen historical Canonical parser, same-host matched run; not a global benchmark claim.

priorCacheControl.scope: Historical synthetic 100-entry batch, not rerun in this review

validation.aggregate: Pending exact-tree available gate; no full-platform pass claimed
